products.name: Freepik AI
products.note: Stock image AI generation; commercial licensing; EU-hosted; content moderation

reading.body:
Freepik offers an AI image generation product for stock imagery, with commercial licensing, EU hosting, and content moderation.

The product sits inside a stock image platform, so its AI output is positioned for designers who need usable, licensable assets rather than experimental generation. EU hosting and content moderation suggest a focus on legal and safety requirements for commercial use.

The data does not cover model size, training compute, inference volume, or energy use. It therefore says nothing about Freepik's compute or power footprint, only about the product's commercial positioning.
